cases.title: Integrations hub renders every registered channel card in manifest card.order order, matching GET /app-api/lms-providers
every channel card renders its manifest card.title, card.description, card.mark, and Connect action routing to /integrations/:channelId/connect
Step 1 of every channel renders Connection name, manifest setup.createFields, registration method radios, and enforces Site URL Rule 1
Step 2 of every channel renders registration URL (dynamic), developer-key-json only when setup.artifacts has it, and exact tool-configuration rows (manual)
Step 3 of every channel renders its manifest setup.bindingFields, pre-fills FieldSpec.default values, and gates Approval code on operatorGrant authority
every channel wizard renders manifest.texts.adminSteps with {LMS} and {tool} filled and zero raw placeholder tokens
lti-generic Dynamic Registration with same-origin endpoints completes without a grant, publishes a course, picks via Deep Linking, and syncs learner score 100

lti-generic Dynamic Registration with a foreign token host stages the platform, switches the wizard to operatorGrant, refuses CLI grant without --confirm-foreign-hosts, and registers with --accept-staged --confirm-foreign-hosts
lti-generic manual wizard refuses a mismatched jwksUrl with GRANT_MISMATCH, registers with matching bound values, and completes publish, Deep Linking, and learner score sync

brightspace manual wizard shows the 9 D2L tool rows and 5 D2L defaults, registers with foreign token host + custom tokenAudience + UUID deployment, and completes Deep Linking and score sync with custom assertion aud
framed Canvas Cloud launch with __Host-lti_state_* stripped from POST /lti/launch/cogniate recovers state via lti.put_data and lti.get_data on https://sso.canvas.sim.test and opens the player
in the same cookie-stripped framed Canvas Cloud launch, lti.get_data.response from another origin or with another message_id is ignored and the frame shows STATE_COOKIE_MISSING after 1.5 s
